name: kyber_rw_domains_8
notes: 5 READs + 3 WRITEs interleaved in ONE async batch (arrival: R8320 W8832 R8384 W8896 R8448 W8960 R8512 R8576). Distinct non-adjacent sector ranges (reads 8320..8583 stride 64, writes 8832..8967 stride 64, 256-sector gap between domains -> no physical merge possible even with --merge-enable=0 ignored by plug merges). Kyber cur_domain round-robin starts scanning from READ (ioext_policy_shared.h iosched_kyber_dispatch: cur_domain=INVALID -> else-branch sets domain=READ), READ batch limit 16 covers all 5 reads, then WRITE batch drains 3 writes: ISSUE = all reads (arrival FIFO) then all writes (arrival FIFO). Loader must pass huge latency targets so depth_limit never shrinks mid-burst.
